ayahs.textArabic: الۤرٰ ۗ كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّوْرِ ەۙ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلٰى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَمِيْدِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alif lām rā, kitābun anzalnāhu ilaika litukhrijan-nāsa minaẓ-ẓulumāti ilan-nūr(i), bi'iżni rabbihim ilā ṣirāṭil-‘azīzil-ḥamīd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Alif. Lam. Ra. A DIVINE WRIT [is this -a revelation] which We have bestowed upon thee from on high in order that thou might bring forth all mankind, by their Sustainer's leave, out of the depths of darkness into the light: onto the way that leads to the Almighty, the One to whom all praise is due -

ayahs.textArabic: اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَهٗ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْكٰفِرِيْنَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيْدٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhil-lażī lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), wa wailul lil-kāfirīna min ‘ażābin syadīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: to God, unto whom all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth belongs. But woe unto those who deny the truth: for suffering severe

ayahs.textArabic: ۨالَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَحِبُّوْنَ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا ۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍۢ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yastaḥibbūnal-ḥayātad-dun-yā ‘alal-ākhirati wa yaṣuddūna ‘an sabīlillāhi wa yabgūnahā ‘iwajā(n), ulā'ika fī ḍalālim ba‘īd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: awaits those who choose the life of this world as the sole object of their love, preferring it to [all thought of] the life to come, and who turn others away from the path of God and try to make it appear crooked. Such as these have indeed gone far astray!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهٖ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۗفَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ وَيَهْدِيْ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ ۗوَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā arsalnā mir rasūlin illā bilisāni qaumihī liyubayyina lahum, fa yuḍillullāhu may yasyā'u wa yahdī may yasyā'(u), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND NEVER have We sent forth any apostle otherwise than [with a message] in his own people's tongue, so that he might make [the truth] clear unto them; but God lets go astray him that wills [to go astray], and guides him that wills [to be guided] -for He alone is almighty, truly wise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَآ اَنْ اَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّوْرِ ەۙ وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِاَيّٰىمِ اللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوْرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad arsalnā mūsā bi'āyātinā an akhrij qaumaka minaẓ-ẓulumāti ilan-nūr(i), wa żakkirhum bi'ayyāmillāh(i), inna fī żālika la'āyātil likulli ṣabbārin syakūr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [thus], indeed, have We sent forth Moses with Our messages [and this Our command]: "Lead thy people out of the depths of darkness into the light, and remind them of the Days of God!" Verily, in this [reminder] there are messages indeed for all who are wholly patient in adversity and deeply grateful [to God].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِقَوْمِهِ اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ اَنْجٰىكُمْ مِّنْ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُوْمُوْنَكُمْ سُوْۤءَ الْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُوْنَ اَبْنَاۤءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُوْنَ نِسَاۤءَكُمْ ۗوَفِيْ ذٰلِكُمْ بَلَاۤءٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż qāla mūsā liqaumihiżkurū ni‘matallāhi ‘alaikum iż anjākum min āli fir‘auna yasūmūnakum sū'al-‘ażābi wa yużabbiḥūna abnā'akum wa yastaḥyūna nisā'akum, wa fī żālikum balā'um mir rabbikum ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, lo Moses spoke [thus] unto his people: "Remember the blessings which God bestowed upon you when He saved you from Pharaoh's people who afflicted you with cruel suffering, and slaughtered your sons, and spared [only] your women -which was an awesome trial from your Sustainer.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ تَاَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَىِٕنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لَاَزِيْدَنَّكُمْ وَلَىِٕنْ كَفَرْتُمْ اِنَّ عَذَابِيْ لَشَدِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż ta'ażżana rabbukum la'in syakartum la'azīdannakum wa la'in kafartum inna ‘ażābī lasyadīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [remember the time] when your Sustainer made [this promise] known: 'If you are grateful [to Me], I shall most certainly give you more and more; but if you are ungrateful, verily, My chastisement will be severe indeed!"'

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ مُوْسٰٓى اِنْ تَكْفُرُوْٓا اَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا ۙفَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيْدٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qāla mūsā in takfurū antum wa man fil-arḍi jamī‘ā(n), fa innallāha laganiyyun ḥamīd(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And Moses added: "If you should [ever] deny the truth-you and whoever else lives on earth, all of you-[know that,] verily, God is indeed self-sufficient, ever to be praised!"

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ ەۗ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۗ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ  ۗجَاۤءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَرَدُّوْٓا اَيْدِيَهُمْ فِيْٓ اَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَآ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَفِيْ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُوْنَنَآ اِلَيْهِ مُرِيْبٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-lażīna min qablikum qaumi nūḥiw wa ‘ādiw wa ṡamūd(a), wal-lażīna mim ba‘dihim,  lā ya‘lamuhum illallāh(u), jā'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyināti fa raddū aidiyahum fī afwāhihim wa qālū innā kafarnā bimā ursiltum bihī wa innā lafī syakkim mimmā tad‘ūnanā ilaihi murīb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: HAVE THE STORIES of those [deniers of the truth] who lived before you never yet come within your ken - [the stories of] the people of Noah, and of [the tribes of] `Ad and Thamud, and of those who came after them? None knows them [now] save God. There came unto them their apostles with all evidence of the truth -but they covered their mouths with their hands and answered: "Behold, we refuse to regard as true the message with which you [claim to] have been entrusted; and, behold, we are in grave doubt, amounting to suspicion, about [the meaning of] your call to us!"

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ اَفِى اللّٰهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ يَدْعُوْكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ ذُنُوْبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۗ قَالُوْٓا اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا ۗ تُرِيْدُوْنَ اَنْ تَصُدُّوْنَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اٰبَاۤؤُنَا فَأْتُوْنَا بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat rusuluhum afillāhi syakkun fāṭiris-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), yad‘ūkum liyagfira lakum min żunūbikum wa yu'akhkhirakum ilā ajalim musammā(n), qālū in antum illā basyarum miṡlunā, turīdūna an taṣuddūnā ‘ammā kāna ya‘budu ābā'unā fa'tūnā bisulṭānim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said the apostles sent unto them: "Can there be any doubt about [the existence and oneness of] God, the Originator of the heavens and the earth? It is He who calls unto you, so that He may forgive you [whatever is past] of your sins and grant you respite until a term [set by Him is fulfilled]." [But] they replied: "You are nothing but mortal men like ourselves! You want to turn us away from what our forefathers were wont to worship: well, then, bring us a clear proof [of your being God's message-bearers]!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ اِنْ نَّحْنُ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَمُنُّ عَلٰى مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖۗ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ اَنْ نَّأْتِيَكُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗوَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat lahum rusuluhum in naḥnu illā basyarum miṡlukum wa lākinnallāha yamunnu ‘alā may yasyā'u min ‘ibādih(ī), wa mā kāna lanā an na'tiyakum bisulṭānin illā bi'iżnillāh(i), wa ‘alallāhi falyatawakkalil-mu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Their apostles answered them: "True, we are nothing but mortal men like yourselves: but God bestows His favour upon whomever He wills of His servants. Withal, it is not within our power to bring you a proof [of our mission], unless it be by God's leave-and [so] it is in God that all believers must place their trust.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا لَنَآ اَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَقَدْ هَدٰىنَا سُبُلَنَاۗ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلٰى مَآ اٰذَيْتُمُوْنَاۗ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā lanā allā natawakkala ‘alallāhi wa qad hadānā subulanā, wa lanaṣbiranna ‘alā mā āżaitumūnā, wa ‘alallāhi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And how could we not place our trust in God, seeing that it is He who has shown us the path which we are to follow? "Hence, we shall certainly bear with patience whatever hurt you may do us: for, all who have trust [in His existence] must place their trust in God [alone]!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِنَآ اَوْ لَتَعُوْدُنَّ فِيْ مِلَّتِنَاۗ فَاَوْحٰٓى اِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min arḍinā au lata‘ūdunna fī millatinā, fa auḥā ilaihim rabbuhum lanuhlikannaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But they who denied the truth spoke [thus] unto their apostles: "We shall most certainly expel you from our land, unless you return forthwith to our ways. Whereupon their Sustainer revealed this to His apostles: "Most certainly shall We destroy these evildoers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۗذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِيْ وَخَافَ وَعِيْدِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lanuskinannakumul-arḍa mim ba‘dihim, żālika liman khāfa maqāmī wa khāfa wa‘īd(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and most certainly shall We cause you to dwell on earth [long] after they have passed away: this is [My promise] unto all who stand in awe of My presence, and stand in awe of My warning!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَاسْتَفْتَحُوْا وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wastaftaḥū wa khāba kullu jabbārin ‘anīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they prayed [to God] that the truth be made to triumph. And [thus it is:] every arrogant enemy of the truth shall be undone [in the life to come],

ayahs.textArabic: مِّنْ وَّرَاۤىِٕهٖ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقٰى مِنْ مَّاۤءٍ صَدِيْدٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Miw warā'ihī jahannamu wa yusqā mim mā'in ṣadīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: with hell awaiting him; and he shall be made to drink of the water of most bitter distress,

ayahs.textArabic: يَّتَجَرَّعُهٗ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيْغُهٗ وَيَأْتِيْهِ الْمَوْتُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَّمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍۗ وَمِنْ وَّرَاۤىِٕهٖ عَذَابٌ غَلِيْظٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Yatajarra‘uhū wa lā yakādu yusīguhū wa ya'tīhil-mautu min kulli makāniw wa mā huwa bimayyit(in), wa miw warā'ihī ‘ażābun galīẓ(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: gulping it [unceasingly,] little by little, and yet hardly able to swallow it. And death will beset him from every quarter - but he shall not die: for [yet more] severe suffering lies ahead of him.

ayahs.textArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ اَعْمَالُهُمْ كَرَمَادِ ِۨاشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيْحُ فِيْ يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍۗ  لَا يَقْدِرُوْنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْا عَلٰى شَيْءٍ ۗذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ الْبَعِيْدُ
ayahs.textLatin: Maṡalul-lażīna kafarū birabbihim a‘māluhum karamādinisytaddat bihir-rīḥu fī yaumin ‘āṣif(in), lā yaqdirūna mimmā kasabū ‘alā syai'(in), żālika huwaḍ-ḍalālul-ba‘īd(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [This, then, is] the parable of those who are bent on denying their Sustainer: all their works are as ashes which the wind blows about fiercely on a stormy day: [in the life to come,] they cannot achieve any benefit whatever from all [the good] that they may have wrought: for this [denial of God] is indeed the farthest one can go astray.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّۗ اِنْ يَّشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara annallāha khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq(i), iy yasya' yużhibkum wa ya'ti bikhalqin jadīd(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: ART THOU NOT aware that God has created the heavens and the earth in accordance with [an inner] truth? He can, if He so wills, do away with you and bring forth a new mankind [in your stead]:

ayahs.textArabic: وَّمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ بِعَزِيْزٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā żālika  ‘alallāhi bi‘azīz(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: nor is this difficult for God.

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَرَزُوْا لِلّٰهِ جَمِيْعًا فَقَالَ الضُّعَفٰۤؤُا لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْٓا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّغْنُوْنَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ۗقَالُوْا لَوْ هَدٰىنَا اللّٰهُ لَهَدَيْنٰكُمْۗ سَوَاۤءٌ عَلَيْنَآ اَجَزِعْنَآ اَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِنْ مَّحِيْصٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa barazū lillāhi jamī‘an fa qālaḍ-ḍu‘afā'u lil-lażīnastakbarū innā kunnā lakum taba‘an fahal antum mugnūna ‘annā min ‘ażābillāhi min syai'(in), qālū lau hadānallāhu lahadainākum, sawā'un ‘alainā ajazi‘nā am ṣabarnā mā lanā mim maḥīṣ(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And all [mankind] will appear before God [on the Day of Judgment]; and then the weak will say unto those who had gloried in their arrogance: "Behold, We were but your followers: can you, then, relieve us of something of God's chastisement?" [And the others] will answer: "If God would but show us the way [to salvation], we would indeed guide you [towards it]. It is [now] all one, as far as we are concerned, whether we grieve impatiently or endure [our lot] with patience: there is no escape for us!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الشَّيْطٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الْاَمْرُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدْتُّكُمْ فَاَخْلَفْتُكُمْۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّنْ سُلْطٰنٍ اِلَّآ اَنْ دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِيْ ۚفَلَا تَلُوْمُوْنِيْ وَلُوْمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَكُمْۗ مَآ اَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ اَنْتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِيَّۗ اِنِّيْ كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ اَشْرَكْتُمُوْنِ مِنْ قَبْلُ ۗاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālasy-syaiṭānu lammā quḍiyal-amru innallāha wa‘adakum wa‘dal-ḥaqqi wa wa‘attukum fa akhlaftukum, wa mā kāna liya ‘alaikum min sulṭānin illā an da‘autukum fastajabtum lī, falā talūmūnī wa lūmū anfusakum, wa mā ana bimuṣrikhikum wa mā antum bimuṣrikhiyy(a), innī kafartu bimā asyraktumūni min qabl(u), innaẓ-ẓālimīna lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when everything will have been decided, Satan will say: "Behold, God promised you something that was bound to come true! I, too, held out [all manner of] promises to you -but I deceived you. Yet I had no power at all over you: I but called you-and you responded unto me. Hence, blame not me, but blame yourselves. It is not for me to respond to your cries, nor for you to respond to mine: for, behold, I have [always] refused to admit that there was any truth in your erstwhile belief that I had a share in God's divinity." Verily, for all evildoers there is grievous suffering in store.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاُدْخِلَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْۗ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيْهَا سَلٰمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa udkhilal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā bi'iżni rabbihim, taḥiyyatuhum fīhā salām(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But those who shall have attained to faith and done righteous deeds will be brought into gardens through which running waters flow, therein to abide by their Sustainer's leave, and will be welcomed with the greeting, "Peace!"

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ اَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَّفَرْعُهَا فِى السَّمَاۤءِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara kaifa ḍaraballāhu maṡalan kalimatan ṭayyibatan kasyajaratin ṭayyibatin aṣluhā ṡābituw wa far‘uhā fis-samā'(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: ART THOU NOT aware how God sets forth the parable of a good word? [It is] like a good tree, firmly rooted, [reaching out] with its branches towards the sky,

ayahs.textArabic: تُؤْتِيْٓ اُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِيْنٍ ۢبِاِذْنِ رَبِّهَاۗ وَيَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ الْاَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Tu'tī ukulahā kulla ḥīnim bi'iżni rabbihā, wa yaḍribullāhul-amṡāla lin-nāsi la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: yielding its fruit at all times by its Sustainer's leave. And [thus it is that] God propounds parables unto men,' so that they might bethink themselves [of the truth].

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيْثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيْثَةِ ِۨاجْتُثَّتْ مِنْ فَوْقِ الْاَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِنْ قَرَارٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa maṡalu kalimatin khabīṡatin kasyajaratin khabīṡatinijtuṡṡat  min fauqil-arḍi mā lahā min qarār(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the parable of a corrupt word is that of a corrupt tree, torn up [from its roots] onto the face of the earth, wholly unable to endure.

ayahs.textArabic: يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِى الْاٰخِرَةِۚ وَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَۗ وَيَفْعَلُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَاۤءُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yuṡabbitullāhul-lażīna āmanū bil-qauliṣ-ṣābiti fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā wa fil-ākhirah(ti), wa yuḍillullāhuẓ-ẓālimīn(a), wa yaf‘alullāhu mā yasyā'(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Thus,] God grants firmness unto those who have attained to faith through the word that is unshakably true in the life of this world as well as in the life to come; but the wrongdoers He lets go astray: for God does whatever He wills.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ بَدَّلُوْا نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ كُفْرًا وَّاَحَلُّوْا قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ الْبَوَارِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara ilal-lażīna baddalū ni‘matallāhi kufraw wa aḥallū qaumahum dāral-bawār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: ART THOU NOT aware of those who have preferred a denial of the truth to God's blessings, and [thereby] invited their people to alight in that abode of utter desolation

ayahs.textArabic: جَهَنَّمَ ۚيَصْلَوْنَهَاۗ وَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Jahannama yaṣlaunahā, wa bi'sal-qarār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: - hell - which they [themselves] will ' have to endure? And how vile a state to settle in!

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلُوْا لِلّٰهِ اَنْدَادًا لِّيُضِلُّوْا عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوْا فَاِنَّ مَصِيْرَكُمْ اِلَى النَّارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alū lillāhi andādal liyuḍillū ‘an sabīlih(ī), qul tamatta‘ū fa inna maṣīrakum ilan-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, they claimed that there are powers that could rival God, and so they strayed from His path. Say: "Enjoy yourselves [in this world], but, verily, the fire will be your journey's end!"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ لِّعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا يُقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَّعَلَانِيَةً مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيْهِ وَلَا خِلٰلٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul li‘ibādiyal-lażīna āmanū yuqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa yunfiqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirraw wa ‘alāniyatam min qabli ay ya'tiya yaumul lā bai‘un fīhi wa lā khilāl(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] tell [those of] My servants who have attained to faith that they should be constant in prayer and spend [in Our way], secretly and openly, out of what We provide for them as sustenance, ere there come a Day when there will be no bargaining, and no mutual befriending.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَاَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً فَاَخْرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۚوَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِيَ فِى الْبَحْرِ بِاَمْرِهٖ ۚوَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْاَنْهٰرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhul-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa akhraja bihī minaṡ-ṡamarāti rizqal lakum, wa sakhkhara lakumul-fulka litajriya fil-baḥri bi'amrih(ī), wa sakhkhara lakumul-anhār(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And remember that] it is God who has created the heavens and the earth, and who sends down water from the sky and thereby brings forth [all manner] of fruits for your sustenance; and who has made ships subservient to. you, so that they may sail through the sea at His behest; and has made the rivers subservient [to His laws, so that they be of use] to you;

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ دَاۤىِٕبَيْنِۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sakhkhara lakumusy-syamsa wal-qamara dā'ibaīn(i), wa sakhkhara lakumul-laila wan-nahār(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and has made the sun and the moon, both of them constant upon their courses, subservient [to His laws, so that they be of use] to you; and has made the night and the day subservient [to His laws, so that they be of use] to you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰتٰىكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مَا سَاَلْتُمُوْهُۗ وَاِنْ تَعُدُّوْا نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحْصُوْهَاۗ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَظَلُوْمٌ كَفَّارٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ātākum min kulli mā sa'altumūh(u), wa in ta‘uddū ni‘matallāhi lā tuḥṣūhā, innal-insāna laẓalūmun kaffār(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [always] does He give you something out of what you may be asking of Him; and should you try to count God's blessings, you could never compute them. [And yet,] behold, man is indeed most persistent in wrongdoing, stubbornly ingrate!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هٰذَا الْبَلَدَ اٰمِنًا وَّاجْنُبْنِيْ وَبَنِيَّ اَنْ نَّعْبُدَ الْاَصْنَامَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż qāla ibrāhīmu rabbij‘al hāżal-balada āminaw wajnubnī wa baniyya an na‘budal-aṣnām(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [remember the time] when Abraham spoke [thus]: "O my Sustainer! Make this land secure, and preserve me and my children from ever worshipping idols -

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ اِنَّهُنَّ اَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِۚ فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِيْ فَاِنَّهٗ مِنِّيْۚ وَمَنْ عَصَانِيْ فَاِنَّكَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbi innahunna  aḍlalna kaṡīram minan-nās(i), faman tabi‘anī fa innahū minnī, wa man ‘aṣānī fa innaka gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, verily, O my Sustainer, these [false objects of worship] have led many people astray! "Hence, [only] he who follows me [in this my faith] ~ is truly of me; and as for him who disobeys me - Thou art, verily, much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ اِنِّيْٓ اَسْكَنْتُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِيْ بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِيْ زَرْعٍ عِنْدَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِۙ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ فَاجْعَلْ اَفْـِٕدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِيْٓ اِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِّنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanā innī askantu min żurriyyatī biwādin gairi żī zar‘in ‘inda baitikal-muḥarram(i), rabbanā liyuqīmuṣ-ṣalāta faj‘al af'idatam minan-nāsi tahwī ilaihim warzuqhum minaṡ-ṡamarāti la‘allahum yasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O our Sustainer! Behold, I have settled some of my offspring in a valley in which there is no arable land, close to Thy sanctified Temple, so that, O our Sustainer, they might devote themselves to prayer: cause Thou, therefore, people's hearts to incline towards them and grant them fruitful sustenance, so that they might have cause to be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِيْ وَمَا نُعْلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخْفٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِى السَّمَاۤءِ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanā innaka ta‘lamu mā nukhfī wa mā nu‘lin(u), wa mā yakhfā ‘alallāhi min syai'in fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O our Sustainer! Thou truly knowest all that we may hide [in our hearts] as well as all that we bring into the open:' for nothing whatever, be it on earth or in heaven, remains hidden from God.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ وَهَبَ لِيْ عَلَى الْكِبَرِ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَاِسْحٰقَۗ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ لَسَمِيْعُ الدُّعَاۤءِ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī wahaba lī ‘alal-kibari ismā‘īla wa isḥāq(a), inna rabbī lasamī‘ud-du‘ā'(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: "All praise is due to God, who has bestowed upon me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Behold, my Sustainer hears indeed all prayer:

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مُقِيْمَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِيْۖ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاۤءِ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbij‘alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min żurriyyatī, rabbanā wa taqabbal du‘ā'(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [hence,] O my Sustainer, cause me and [some] of my offspring to remain constant in prayer! "And, O our Sustainer, accept this my prayer:

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الْحِسَابُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanagfir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yauma yaqūmul-ḥisāb(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Grant Thy forgiveness unto me, and my parents, and all the believers, on the Day on which the [last] reckoning will come to pass!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللّٰهَ غَافِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ ەۗ اِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيْهِ الْاَبْصَارُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā taḥsabannallāha gāfilan ‘ammā ya‘maluẓ-ẓālimūn(a), innamā yu'akhkhiruhum liyaumin tasykhaṣu fīhil-abṣār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND DO NOT think that God is unaware of what the evildoers are doing: He but grants them respite until the Day when their eyes will stare in horror,

ayahs.textArabic: مُهْطِعِيْنَ مُقْنِعِيْ رُءُوْسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ اِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۚوَاَفْـِٕدَتُهُمْ هَوَاۤءٌ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Muhṭi‘īna muqni‘ī ru'ūsihim lā yartaddu ilaihim ṭarfuhum, wa af'idatuhum hawā'(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: the while they will be running confusedly to and fro, with their heads upraised [in supplication], unable to look away from what they shall behold, and their hearts an abysmal void.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيْهِمُ الْعَذَابُۙ فَيَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا رَبَّنَآ اَخِّرْنَآ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ قَرِيْبٍۙ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَۗ اَوَلَمْ تَكُوْنُوْٓا اَقْسَمْتُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلُ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ زَوَالٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anżirin-nāsa yauma ya'tīhimul-‘ażāb(u), fa yaqūlul-lażīna ẓalamū rabbanā akhkhirnā ilā ajalin qarīb(in), nujib da‘wataka wa nattabi‘ir-rusul(a), awalam takūnū aqsamtum min qablu mā lakum min zawāl(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, warn men of the Day when this suffering may befall them, and when those who did wrong [in their lifetime] will exclaim: "O our Sustainer! Grant us respite for a short while, so that we might respond to Thy call and follow the apostles!" [But God will answer:] "Why - were you not aforetime wont to swear that no kind of resurrection and retribution awaited you?

ayahs.textArabic: وَّسَكَنْتُمْ فِيْ مَسٰكِنِ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْاَمْثَالَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sakantum fī masākinil-lażīna ẓalamū anfusahum wa tabayyana lakum kaifa fa‘alnā bihim wa ḍarabnā lakumul-amṡāl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, you dwelt in the dwelling-places of those who had sinned against their own selves [before your time], and it was made obvious to you how We had dealt with them: for We have set forth unto you many a parable [of sin, resurrection and divine retribution]."

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوْا مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِنْدَ اللّٰهِ مَكْرُهُمْۗ وَاِنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُوْلَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qad makarū makrahum wa ‘indallāhi makruhum, wa in kāna makruhum litazūla minhul-jibāl(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [this retribution will befall all evildoers because] they devise that false imagery of theirs - and all their false imagery is within God's knowledge. [And never can the blasphemers prevail against the truth - not] even if their false imagery were so (well devised and so powerful] that mountains could be moved thereby.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللّٰهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهٖ رُسُلَهٗ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيْزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā taḥsabannallāha mukhlifa wa‘dihī rusulah(ū), innallāha ‘azīzun żun tiqām(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: HENCE, do not think that God will fail to fulfil the promise which He gave to His apostles: verily, God is almighty, an avenger of evil!

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْاَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ وَبَرَزُوْا لِلّٰهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tubaddalul-arḍu gairal-arḍi was-samāwātu wa barazū lillāhil-wāḥidil-qahhār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [His promise will be fulfilled] on the Day when the earth shall be changed into another earth, as shall be the heavens and when [all men] shall appear before God, the One who holds absolute sway over all that exists.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ مُّقَرَّنِيْنَ فِى الْاَصْفَادِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa taral-mujrimīna yauma'iżim muqarranīna fil-aṣfād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: For on that Day thou wilt see all who were lost in sin linked together in fetters,

ayahs.textArabic: سَرَابِيْلُهُمْ مِّنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَّتَغْشٰى وُجُوْهَهُمُ النَّارُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Sarābīluhum min qaṭirāniw wa tagsyā wujūhahumun-nār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: clothed in garments of black pitch, with fire veiling their faces.

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَجْزِيَ اللّٰهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyajziyallāhu kulla nafsim mā kasabat, innallāha sarī‘ul-ḥisāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And all shall be judged on that Day,] so that God may requite every human being for all that he has earned [in life]: verily, God is swift in reckoning!

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا بَلٰغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنْذَرُوْا بِهٖ وَلِيَعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ وَّلِيَذَّكَّرَ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā balāgul lin-nāsi wa liyunżarū bihī wa liya‘lamū annamā huwa ilāhuw wāḥiduw wa liyażżakkara ulul-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: THIS IS A MESSAGE unto all mankind. Hence, let them be warned thereby, and let them know that He is the One and Only God; and let those who are endowed with insight take this to heart!
